title: Garlic Scape Goat Cheese Dip
description: This garlic scape goat cheese dip recipe is great served with fresh veggies or pita chips. Garnish with toasted pecans. Refrigerate before serving.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) package goat cheese, at room temperature
1 (4 ounce) package cream cheese, at room temperature
6 fresh garlic scapes, minced, or more to taste, divided

steps.text: Combine goat cheese, cream cheese, 5 garlic scapes, lemon zest, lemon juice, garlic, and salt in a bowl with a fork until blended. Transfer to a bowl; garnish with remaining 1 garlic scape and pecans.

video.description: Full of zesty creaminess and pure garlicky flavor from garlic scapes, this dip delivers freshness and flavor in every bite. Combine chopped fresh garlic scapes with goat cheese, cream cheese, minced garlic, lemon juice and lemon zest. Finally, add some awesome crunch with a garnish of toasted pecans. Serve with fresh veggies, crackers or thin miniature toasts and watch this cheese dip quickly disappear!
